text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, Dec 17 - Chittagong - 22 vessels in port of which 4 containers, 7 general cargo, 1 cement, 1 foodgrain, 2 tankers, 1 rapeseed, 1 fertiliser, 1 cement clinker, 4 other vessels. 21 Vessels due by 24/12 of which 8 containers, 6 general cargo, 2 cement, 1 ro/ro, 1 foodgrain, 1 export loader, 1 tanker, 1 other. No berthing delays, port working normally.

INDIA, Dec 17 - Haldia - Due to severe deterioration of Jellinghan Bar inward and outward, drafts for Haldia have been cut by 0.3 metre for the remainder of December with immediate effect. No other information received.

MALAYSIA, Dec 18 - Port Kelang - North/south port - Container/ro/ro berth - 7 Vessels alongside, 12 waiting, 1 day waiting time. Dry/cement bulk terminal - 2 Vessels alongside, 6 waiting, 6 days waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 3 Vessels alongside, 1 berthed, 1 waiting, 1 day waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - 4 Vessels alongside, 10 waiting, 1 days waiting time. Light draft conventional wharf No. 7 south port - Closed for repairs. Deep draft conventional wharf no. 18 north port - Closed for repairs. Bulk terminal wharf no. 25 - Closed for repairs. West port - Container/ro/ro berth - 1 Vessel alongside, none waiting, no waiting time. Bulk cement terminal - 1 Vessel alongside, none waiting, 4 days waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf - 6 Vessels alongside, 2 waiting, 2 days waiting time. Liquid bulk terminal - No vessels, no waiting time. Deep draft conventional wharf no. 6 - Closed for dredging operations.

MAURITIUS, Dec 17 - Port Louis - Vessels alongside discharging and loading, 2 containers, 3 general cargo. 1 Vessel waiting at outer anchorage to load bulk sugar. 1 Container vessel awaiting berth for discharging. No idle vessels. 20 Fishing vessels bunkering and discharging. Port working normally.

PAKISTAN, Dec 16 - Karachi - 12 Vessels due, up to 24 hours delay expected. 6 Rice vessels loading at berth, 2 containers loading and discharging at berth. 9 Vessels discharging at berth (general cargo, dap, tallow, urea and gas oil. 1 Rice waiting at anchorage to load, 5 vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (containers, fertiliser, sugar, hsd). 3 Vessels awaiting orders. Port Qasim - Six vessels discharging at berth (fuel oil, sugar, wheat, part cargo and coal). 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (steel slabs, sugar, jute and wheat). No vessels waiting at anchorage to load.

PHILIPPINES, Dec 16 - Manila - South harbour - 12 Vessels discharging at pier berth, 7 discharging at anchorage, 5 waiting at outside anchorage to discharge. Average waiting time for vessels with a draft of less than 8 metres and an loa less than 130 metres, 1 day. For vessels with a draft greater than 9 metres and an loa greater than 140 metres, 1 day.

SOUTH KOREA, Dec 17 - Inchon - 68 Vessels in port (44 berthed, 24 anchored) of which 11 general cargo, 9 logs, 5 corn, 3 each containers, plywood, 2 each coils, cars, wheat, 1 each raw sugar, molasses, alfalfa, soda, palm oil, steel, pig iron. Anchored, 7 logs, 5 general cargo, 4 cars, 2 plywood, 1 each wheat blending pellets, corn, cotton seed meal, wheat, containers, pulp, approx. 3-4 days delay expected. Busan - 169 Vessels in port (48 berthed, 121 anchored including 60 laid up) of which 33 general cargo, 8 containers, 4 scrap, 3 coal. 61 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 4 days delay expected.

Pohang - 27 Vessels in port (20 berthed, 7 anchored) of which discharging, 3 scrap, 2 each coils, pipes, 1 each coal, iron ore, talc powder, plate, chrome. 8 Vessels loading steel. 7 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 2-3 days delay expected. Ulsan - 23 Vessels in port (20 berthed, 3 anchored) of which discharging, 2 crude oil, 1 each feed meal, fertiliser, styrene monomer, mono ethyl glycol, woodchip, caustic soda,, corn, propane, bunker-c. Loading, 3 general cargo, 1 each fertiliser, ethanol, steel pipes, chemicals, fuel oil. 3 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 3 days delay expected. Masan - Six vessels berthed of which discharging, 2 steel scrap, 1 each pulp, pig iron, logs. 1 Container vessel loading, no berthing delays expected.

TAIWAN, Dec 16 - Keelung - Vessels in port, 12 containers, 3 tankers, 11 other bulkers, 3 general cargo. Vessels waiting at outer anchorage 5 containers, 1 tanker. Delays 16 hours for containers, 2 days for tankers. Three vessels anchored. Berthing delay grain, coal 3 days, steel, iron ore 2 days. Kaohsiung - One vessel anchored. Berthing delays grain, coal/scrap, steel 1 day, iron/coal 2 days (CSC berth). Taichung - Five vessels anchored. Delays grain 2 days, others 1 day.

SIERRA LEONE, Dec 16 - Freetown - Vessels due, 1 container/vehicle discharger, 2 container dischargers, 1 cruise vessel, no delays expected. Discharging/loading at berth, 1 rice discharger, 1 fertiliser discharger. 1 Load stores for Ecomog, 1 vessel under repair. Vessels anchored, 1 cargo vessel. Vessels must endeavour to be in/out of port before 1900 hours.

SINGAPORE, Dec 17 - Singapore - Tanjong Pagar container terminal - 12 Container vessels berthed. Keppel terminal - 15 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Pasir Panjang - 8 Container/general cargo vessels berthed. Sembawang - 1 General cargo vessel berthed. Jurong port - 3 Bulk cargo/steel/general cargo vessels berthed. Oil terminal/sbm buoys - 21 Tankers berthed. Minimum berthing delays at all facilities.

SRI LANKA, Dec 17 - Colombo - Vessels due, 1 breakbulk, 3 containers. 2-3 Days delay for conventional vessels. 17 Vessels loading at berth of which 4 essential services, 13 containers. 27 Vessels discharging at berth of which 1 bagged sugar, 4 general cargo, 2 bagged flour, 13 containers, 3 bagged fertiliser, 1 bulk lpg, 1 bagged maize, 2 ro/ro. 2 Container vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting at anchorage to discharge of which 2 containers, 1 bagged fertiliser. 2 Vessels bunkering, 8 under repair/drydocks, 1 awaiting orders. Galle - No vessels in port. Trincomalee - Two vessels loading at berth.
